tei:div.tei:p: (1na)chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ gnas lugs gnyis kyi man ngag dang go cha gnyis kyi man ngag bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de// lus ngag yid gsum sprin tshogs kyis// dus gsum du ni mthong phyag 'tshal// gnyis med gsal ba chos kyi dbyings// mchog de la yang phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma chen po nā ro pas// bde mchog 'khor lo'i gsang sngags ni// 'bum phrag gcig ni bzlas pa yis// sa ni g.yos shing lung bstan thob/ tai lo pa la brten zhes thos/ /shar phyogs ngos kyi tai lo pa'i// zhal sngar gdams ngag mnos pa ni/ lo bcu gnyis su dka' ba spyad pa'i mthar/ snyan mchog bcad nas/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bkod nas phul ste zhus pas/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// de la dngos po'i gnas lugs ni// lus ni byang chub rnam lnga dang*// rtsa dang byang chub sems dang ni// mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis// lus kyi chos ni (2na)bstan pa yin// zhes gsungs so// de la/ rang sems dngos rig pa dang stong pa dbyer mi phyed pa'i/ po'i gnas lugs ni/ kye ho 'di ni sems kyi de kho na nyid/ rang rig ye shes te// ngag gi spyod yul lam las brjod pa'i sgra dang blo'i yul las shes pa/ tshig dang yi ger/ 'das// tai lo nga ni bstan du ci yang med// rang gis rang nyid rang rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshon te shes par byos// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ tai lo pa'i chos drug ste/ mi mno/ yid dang bral/ mi sems/ blo dang bral/ mi dpyod/ yul dang bral lo/ mi sgom/ dmigs pa dang bral/ mi bsam/ smon pa dang bral/ sems 'od gsal gyi ngang 'ba' zhig rang bzhin du gnas so// zhes gsungs so// lam gyi gnas thabs rnam gnyis te// bskyed pa yi ni rim pa dang*// rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'o// de la bskyed pa'i rim tshul ni// (2ba)skad cig dran rdzogs la sogs pa// lha sku sgyu mar bskyed byas la// rdzogs pa'i rim pa mtshan bcas dang*// mtshan med rnal 'byor gang sgom yang*// lus kyi gnad dang yul gyi gnad// dus gnad gsum las ye shes 'char// lus kyi gnad la rnam gnyis te// lus gnad dngos dang der brten pa'i// rlung gi sbyor ba sgom pa'o// de yang rdo rje gdan bzhi las/

lus sems srog gi dbyug pa la// sbyor ba drug gi lus lhar gsal ba'i dkyil na yar dhū ti yod par bsam/ re'u mig ltar bsnol/ lcags kyu ltar dgug /mu tig ltar brtsegs/ rgya mdud ltar bsdam/ li khri ltar bsgrim/ rgod gshog ltar brgyang*/ yan lag gnas// thabs dang bcas na shin tu 'bar// zhes gsungs so// dang po lus gnad dngos bstan pa// rkang pa re'u mig lta bur drod skye/ bsnol bar bya// mnyam bzhag rgya bde ba bskyed/ yis btsir bar bya// li khri bzhin du khong bsgrim bya// sgal pa chu shing bzhin du bsrang*/ rgya mdud bzhin du bsdam par bya// mgrin pa lcags kyu bzhin du dgug par bya/ dpung pa/ 'phel ka bzhin du bskyed par bya// rin chen rtsar la bstar ba 'dra// sgal pa mu tig brtsegs pa lta bur bya// shin tu bsrangs la dgug par bya// lus la brten pa'i rlung sbyor ni// dbugs la sbyor ba bzhi ldan bya// dbugs kyi sbyor bzhi ma shes na// gong gi yon tan 'byung bar dka'// zhes gsungs so/// /rngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang*// mda' ltar 'phang dang rnam bzhis so// rngub pa yis ni dbang du byed/ rngub pa ni/ steng du rlung khru gang tsam nas rngubs la/ rtsa gsum na mar (3na)song bas/ lte ba nas sor bzhi'i sar/ dhū ti la thim pa'o// dgang ba yis ni rengs par byed// mi thub na cung zad glod pa'o// gzhil ba yis ni zhi bar byed// mda' ltar gyen du 'phang la sogs pa nas/ bar bya// de ni rlung gi gnas su gsungs// yang byang chub sems kyis 'khor lo bzhi bkang nas/ dgang ba yis ni lus bkang nas// zhes pa dang*/ yul gyi gnad ni rnam gnyis te// phyi nang gnyis su shes par bya// phyi ni dkar dmar rnam pa can// nang du 'khor lo rnam pa bzhi// de la thabs lam bgrang mi lang*// mi rtog don la dmigs kyang rung*// thig le nya gang ba gcig dmigs kyang rung*// yar sreg mar 'dren bzhu brtul byed kyang rung*// phyag rgya chen po nyid la dmigs kyang rung*// shes pa rnam rtog yul la ma 'phros na// de rnams gsal ba med kyang ni// rnam par rtog pa ngang gi 'gag

/yon tan rnams kyang rim gyis 'byung*// de ni yul gyi gnad nyid do// de la dus gnad bstan pa ni// g.yas g.yon 'pho dus zer ba yod// gnyid dang snying ga rmi lam mgrin pa/ snyoms spyi bo/ 'jug dang*// tha mal de rnams la shes pa gtad pas/ rlung 'ching bar 'gyur ro// dus dang rnam pa bzhi// de la dus bzhi'i nyams len ni// zhal las shes par bya ba yin// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa ni// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob// de la mchog ni gong ltar bsgoms pas/ dang po drod 'byung*/ de nas bde ba 'byung*/ de nas srin bu me khyer la sogs pa'i rtags rnams 'byung*/ de nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la phyam tser 'gro ste/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob bo// brtan pa'i (3ba)tshad ni/ dbang po'i yul gsum mthong ba'o// thabs bde gsal/ shes rab stong nyid/ thabs shes zung 'jug gi bde ba dbyer mi phyed pa bde ba chen po'i sku/ ma skyes pa chos sku/ sna tshogs su snang ba sprul sku/ rang bzhin longs sku/ 'di gsum dbyer mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o// gtum mo dgu skor gyi zhal gdams lags so// //na mo gu ru/ de nas dngos po'i gnas lugs la gnyis te/ lus dngos po'i gnas lugs dang*/ sems dngos po'i gnas lugs so// lus dngos po'i gnas lugs ni/ lus ni byang chub rnam lnga dang*// zhes pas bstan te/ de yang rtogs na mngon par byang chub pa rnam pa lnga ste/ chos nyid stong pa la byang chub pa/ pha ma'i byang sems dkar dmar de gdan pad zla la byang chub pa/ de gnyis 'dres pa'i thig le de/ gsung yig 'bru la byang chub pa/ de nas lte ba srid pa'i 'khor lo ru rdo rje lta bu cig chags te/ de thugs phyag mtshan la byang chub pa/ de nas da lta'i lus 'di sku yongs su rdzogs pa la byang chub pa'o// rtsa dang zhes pa'i rtsa ni/ 'khor lo bzhi'i grangs kyi rtsa 'dab brgya nyi shu ste/

de yang bsdu na gsum ste/ rkyang ma g.yas thabs gzung ba dag pa/ kyi rtsa rlung gi rang bzhin sngon po/ ro ma g.yon shes rab kyi rtsa 'dzin pa dag pa/ me'i rang bzhin dmar mo/ dbus a gzung ba dang 'dzin pa gnyis ka dag pa/ wa dhū ti srog rtsa byang sems rang bzhin dkar po'o// mi gtsang zhes pa ni/ mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis// lus kyi chos ni gnas pa yin// zhes so// gnyis pa sems dngos po'i gnas lugs ni/ de yang*/ kye ho zhes pa ni bod pa'am/ (4na)brda'i tshig ste/ tshur shog cig pa'o// 'di ni zhes pa bla ma'i brdas mtshon nas/ rang gi sems nyid rang rig pa rtogs pa'o// ngag gi spyod yul zhes pa tha snyad kyi sgro skur dang tha mal gyi brjod tshig las 'das pa'o// tai lo ngas ni zhes pa chos nyid 'od gsal de dang po nas rang bzhin gyis 'char bas so// rang gis zhes pa/ rang gi sems nyid gnyug ma 'di ngo shes pa'o// ye shes zhes pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa ste/ ye shes de rang gi rgyud la gnas pa shes par bya'o// sems 'di ci la yang mi gnas/ 'dus byas ci la yang mi bsam/ log pa'i ting nge 'dzin yang mi sems/ mtshan ma gang la yang mi sgom/ rig pa 'di ci la yang mi dpyad/ ma bcos/ mi bcos/ bcos ma ma yin par bzhag par bya'o// da lam gyi rim pa ni/ rang lus thabs ldan la rnam pa gsum ste/ de la lus kyi gnad/ yul gyi gnad/ dmigs pa dus kyi gnad nam langs nyi ma shar tho rangs/ gsum mo// lus gnad ni/ rkang pa skyil krung*/ sgal tshigs rin po che rtsar la brgyus pa dang 'dra/ gos kyi thong ka yangs par bya/ lce rtse rkan la sbyar/ mig sna gong du phab/ lag pa gnyis lte ba'i 'og tu mnyam par bzhag /re'u mig ltar bsnol/ rgya mdud ltar bcing*/ mda' ltar bsrang ba ste/ lus dngos po'i thabs so// mda' ltar 'phang*/ lcags kyu ltar bkug / 'og go sgo/ 'khor lo ltar bskor/ rlung bcos pa'i thabs so// li dri ltar sgrim/

lte ba nas/ thig le ltar gdal/ tsha tsha ltar spros/ yan lag la 'byung ba ro snyoms pa zhes bya ba/ (4ba)sems bcos pa'i thabs so// gtum mo dgu skor gyi zhal gdams so// ༈ //'khor lo drug gi gdams pa lags so// na mo gu ru/ lus dpag bsam gyi sdong po la/ skyes bu dad ldan bsod nams bsags pas/ rtsa a wa dhū ti gnas/ de la 'khor lo rnam pa bzhi yod/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo na/ ye shes kyi rtsa 'dab ma drug cu rtsa gnyis/ de'i grong khyer na/ sems kyi rgyal po ti la ka bya ba bzhugs/ de'i zhal blta bar 'dod na/ shes rab kyi lde mig gis/ rnam rtog gi sgo lcags bkrol nas/ sgo de phye na zhal mthong ste 'ong*/ mthong na/ thun mong gi dngos grub dang*/ mchog gi dngos grub gnyis ga 'grub bo// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo na/ chos sku'i gnas gzhu kha sbyor lta bu der gtad na mchog tu dga' ba skye/ rtsa 'dab ma brgyad yod/ de na sems kyi rgyal po ba san+ta bzhugs/ de'i zhal lta bar 'dod na zhes sogs gong gis 'gre/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo na/ longs sku'i gnas/ dar gyi pha ldo bcad pa lta bu yin/ der shes pa gtad na/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba skyed/ rtsa 'dab ma bcu drug yod/ de na yid kyi thig le bzhugs/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo na/ sku gsum gyi ngo bo gcig tu rtogs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku gnas/ rtsa ni sbrul 'khyil ba lta bu/ der shes pa gtad na lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba skye/ lus thams cad la khyab pa'i bde ba chags pa dang bsre/ rtsa 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis yod/ de na ye shes kyi thig le bya ba bzhugs/ 'khor lo bzhi na gnad bzhi yod de/ lte ba gtum mo'i gnad/ snang ba sems gsal stong du shar ba de bsre/ mgrin pa rmi lam gyi gnad/ sgyu mar bsre/ snying ga gnyid kyi gnad/ 'od gsal shar te bsre/ spyi bo snyoms 'jug gi gnad/ chags pa dang bde ba/

rdo rje nor bu dang*/ bde ba'i gnad/ gnyid kyi gnad/ smin (5na)mtshams gnyis te drug go /de rnams gnad du 'ong ba ci ste zhe na/ de na shes pa'i rten yod pas na gnad yin/ dmigs pa gtad thabs ni/ lte ba'i me la shes pa gtad pas/ rlung sems gnyis su med pa'i gnad kas/ rlung gis bsrubs pas rtsa sgo byed nas rlung a wa dhū tir tshud/ rlung dhū tir tshud pas rtog med kyi ye shes 'char/ de yang*/ lus la dmigs pa ni shes rab la/ rlung gis rtsa sgo bye ba ni/ shes rab kyis rnam rtogs gi sgo lcags phyed pa yin/ rtog med kyi ye shes mthong ba ni/ sems kyi rgyal po zhal mthong ba'o/// / mchog gi gtum mo'i gdams pa lags/ bla ma grub thob rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon chen po nā ro pas// gsang sngags rgyal po yi ge bdun/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ /'bum phrag gcig ni bzlas pa yis// sa ni g.yos shing lung bstan thob// shar phyogs ngos kyi tai lo pa'i// zhal sngar gdams ngag mnos pa ni// dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// de yang gsang ba 'dus pa las// 'od gsal ba la stong pa che// de la thabs ni sna tshogs 'byung*// zhes gsungs pas/ dngos po'i gnas lugs la gnyis te/ lus dang sems su shes par bya// lus kyi gnad ma shes na/ sgom pa'i gnad mi shes/ de ma shes na/ sems mi zin pas/ des na/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo na skye ba med pa mtshon pa'i yi ge a gnas/ de la skye ba med pa'i rtsa a wa dhū ti byung*/ yar tshangs pa'i bu gar zug /mar gnyer po che la zug /ro rkyang gnyis yar sna sgor zug /mar spu sna gu'i mtshams su zug /gdugs dang shing (5ba)lta bur gnas pa 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas par bsgom/ de yang*/ lus ni byang chub rnam lnga dang*// rtsa dang byang chub sems dang ni// mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis// lus kyi chos ni gnas pa yin// zhes gsungs so// sems kyi gnas lugs bstan pa ni/

kye ho 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min// tai lo pa la ci yang bstan du med// rang gis rang rig mtshon te shes par byos// zhes gsungs so// tai lo pa'i chos drug ni/ mi mno/ mi sems/ mi dpyod/ mi sgom/ mi bsam/ sems rang bzhin du gnas so// de la lam gyi rim pa la/ gnad ni rnam pa gsum yin te/ lus dang yul dang dus dang ngo*// lus ni rdo rje'i skyil krung ngo*// sgal tshigs rin chen rtsar la rgyus// thong ka rgyun du yangs par bya// ltong mgo shin tu sba bar bya// lce ni ya rkan nyid du gtad// mnyam bzhag phyag rgya lte ba'i 'og tu/ btsir bar bya// yang na lus ni tsog pur bsdad// re'u mig bzhin du bsnol bar bya// rgya mdud bzhin du bsdam par bya// lcags kyu bzhin du dgug par bya// mda' ltar gyen du 'phangs byas pas// nam mkha'i ba ni rim gyis 'jo// yang na ol kos ol mdud mnan// yang na mjing pas ltag pa mnan// g.yas nas rgyu na g.yas rtsa mnan// g.yon nas rgyu na g.yon rtsa mnan// pho rlung 'dul zhing mo rlung sbyang*// ma ning rlung sbyang rgyun du bsgom// de yang*/ rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gdan bzhi las/ lus sems srog gi dbyug pa la// sbyor ba drug gi yan lag gnas// thabs dang bcas na shin tu 'bar// zhes (6na)gsungs so// dbugs kyi bzhi ldan ma shes na// gong gi yon tan 'byung bar dka'// de yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro las// dgang ba yis ni lus bkang na// dug dang rims kyi tsha ba 'phrog /bum pa can gyis sgo bcings na// sgo yi bu ga dag par 'gyur// 'thor ba sna tshogs rdul du bya// rab tu zhi ba zhi bar 'gyur// seng ge rnam grol phyag rgya ni// rnal 'byor pa yis bcings nas su// rtag tu srog dang rtsol ba bya// zhes gsungs so// kyai rdo rje las/ rngub pa yis ni dbang du byed// dgang ba yis ni rengs par byed// gzhil ba yis ni zhi bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// rim lnga las/

lte ba chu so tshangs 'khor lo// gru gsum dkar zhing dmar ba la// thig le kha dog lnga bsam ste// sangs rgyas lnga ru mtshon par bya// srog 'gog pa dang ldan byas na// skad cig de la 'bar bar 'gyur// 'jig rten khams rnams mchod pa'i gnas// rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// yul gyi gnad ni gnyis yin te// phyi rol dkar dmar yul gyi gnad// rig ma mtshan ldan yul gyi gnad// nang gis 'khor lo bzhi la gtad// lte ba sprul sku dga' bzhi skye// dus kyi gnad ni bzhi yin te// tha mal dus su lte bar sems kyi rgyal po gnas/ der gtad na/ lus thams cad kyi gnas su bde ba skye/ snyoms 'jug dus su spyi bor bde chen du gtad na/ lus thams cad la khyab pa'i bde ba skye/ gnyid log bya ba'i dus su snying gar gtad na/ lus kyi gnad du mchog tu dga' ba skye/ rmi lam dus su mgrin par gtad na/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba skye/ yul ni 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'dra// gdan bzhi las/ lte ba chu shing snying po gnas// snying gar yang ni 'greng ste gnas// rtag (6ba)tu stong pa sgom yin te// mkhas pas rtag tu bzlas pa bya// sgom dang bzlas pa'i khyad par gyis// gang gis lam na zhugs gyur na// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// ces gsungs so// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa ni// mchog dang thun mong gnyis yin te// thun mong rim pa bstan pa ni// dang po 'gro ba lta bu 'byung*/ de'i rkyen gyis/ a wa dhū tir rlung tshud na/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyun du shar nas/ mchog gi dngos grub thob nas/ skye ba 'di la sangs rgya'o// 'di ni tai lo pas/ nā ro pa la/ des mar pa la/ des bla ma mi la la/ des mgon po zla 'od gzhon nu la gdams pa'o// mchog gi gtum mo/ mar pa'i man ngag go// /

sgyu lus lnga ldan lags/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgyu lus la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ sngon 'gro gtum mo dang 'dra/ dngos gzhi la lnga las/ dang po rmi lam gyi 'du shes sngon du btang ba ni/ chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu yin pas/ bde ba thams cad kyang rmi lam yin te/ kha sang lta bu cig bdag gis 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la longs spyod pa dang*/ mdang gi rmi lam na longs spyod pa gnyis/ di ring gi nyi ma la khyad med de/ de bas na/ bde ba thams cad kyang rmi lam lta bu 'dug go /de bzhin du sdug bsngal thams cad kyang rmi lam lta bu yin te/ lo gnyis gsum la sogs pa'i gong du bdag gis sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba dang*/ mdang gi rmi lam na myong ba gnyis de ring nyi ma la khyad med de/ de bas na/ sdug bsngal thams cad kyang rmi lam lta bur 'dug go /de ltar na/ chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu yin pas/ rmi lam rmi bar bya snyam du 'dun pa dung dung bya'o// de yang*/ tha mal (7na)pa'i rmi lam lta bu ma yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams blta ba'am/ yi dam lha'i zhal blta ba'am/ lha'i yul lam/ rdo rje gdan nam/ 'dzam bu'i gling lta bu'am/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba'am/ lus la me 'bar ba'am/ chu 'bab pa la sogs ngo mtshar can gyi rmi lam rmi bar bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa dungs pa btang ngo*// de lta bu'i bsam pa de yang*/ dang po yun ring du bsam/ de nas mal du zhugs pa dang yang snga ma ltar bsam mo// de nas gnyid mi 'ong ba 'ong bar bya ba ni/ gnyid du thum gyis 'gro khar/ smin bar du thig le mthe bong tsam dkar ri le ba cig la shes pa bsdus la nyal lo// bsdus drags na gnyid mi 'ong ngo*// de nas sngar gyi bag chags kyi stobs kyis rmi lam rmi ste/ dper na 'khrug pa la sogs pa'i ltad mo bltas tsa na/ gnyid thum byung ma thag de dag rmi ba dang 'dra'o/// /de nas/ rmi lam la der ngo shes pa ni/

rmi lam du byung ma thag tu yang dag tu 'dzin pa mi 'byung ste/ de yang*/ rmi lam gyi khyi dang bud med la sogs pa gang byung yang*/ de nyid rmi lam gyi khyi dang bud med du ngo shes pa'o// de nas spel ba ni/ rmi lam ci rmi ba de gcig las gnyis su spel lo// de nas je mang je mang stong gsum tsam spel lo// de la goms pa dang*/ rmi lam sbyang ba ni/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan la sogs pa dang ldan par bsgom/ de thams cad sgyu ma'am/ 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pa lta bur bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pas chu zla lta bu'i lha tshogs rnams zhal mngon sum du mthong la/ de nas de rnams la dngos su chos nyan pa dang*/ gdams ngag zhus (7ba)pas/ rang la zag med kyi bde ba phril phril skye'o// de ni bla ma'i man ngag gsung pa'i dus su go rim de ltar skye gsung ngo*// nyams su myong ba'i dbang du byas na/ rmi lam du ngo shes pa'i dus su/ zag med kyi bde ba phril phril skye ste/ de nas spel ba dang sbyangs ba la 'bad rtsol bya mi dgos shing*/ tshegs med par 'grub pas/ de gnyis yan lag tu 'gro gsung ngo*// de yan gyis dngos gzhi bstan pa'o// gsum pa rjes la gnyis las/ gang zag brtson 'grus can tshe 'di la sangs rgya ba ni/ dngos gzhi'i dus chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur nyams su myong ba des/ rjes thob la sngar gyi chos thams cad de ltar yid la byas pa tsam gyis/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur rgyud la sngar gyi nyams myong yod pa'i stobs kyis skye'o// yang na me long nang gi gzugs brnyan la bslab pa yang skabs su bya gsung*/ de ltar spyod lam thams cad du 'bad rtsol dang bcas nas bsgoms pas/ ci zhig tsa na sgom mi dgos par/ de ltar nyams su myong ba 'byung ste/ de dus yid ches pa'i rtags kyang 'byung*/

yi dam lha'i lung bstan yang 'byung ngo*// de brtag pa phyi ma'i le'u gnyis pa nas 'byung ba bzhin du/ spyod pa mthar phyin nas/ zla ba gsum dang zhag drug na sangs rgya'o// le lo can bar dor sangs rgya ba ni/ rmi lam gyi dus su sgyu lus kyi nyams su myong ba skye yang*/ rjes la snang grags kyi chos thams cad dang sbyar nas sgom pa ma khom na/ bar dor sgyu lus zin par byas na/ bar dor sangs rgya bar bya ste/ de yang zla ba re la rmi lam du ngo shes pas kyang*/ bar do la bar (8na)do shes pa 'byung ste/ de yang 'chi bar 'dug ang snyam pa dang*/ shi nas kyang bar dor lus mi len snyam pa dang de ltar 'du shes sngon song bas/ 'chi ba'i dus su 'byung ba rnams rim gyis bsdu ste/ de yang dang po sa chu la thim/ chu me la thim/ me rlung la thim/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim/ rnam par shes pa snang ba rags pa la/ snang ba rags pa phra ba la/ phra ba shin tu phra ba la thim nas snang ba 'gags te/ bar dor 'phos nas/ yid kyi gzugs can du gnas pa'i dus su/ bar do shes par bya'o snyam pa'i sngar gyi 'phen pas/ bar do ngo shes pa 'byung ngo*// de ltar ngo shes pas/ zag pa med pa nyams su myong ba 'byung bas/ de nyid du/ 'bras bu sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can thob par 'gyur ro// bar do la bar dor shes par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa dung dung ba bya ste/ de la der ngo shes pa dang*/ rang gi rgyud la zag med kyi bde ba phril gyis 'byung ste/ der yid kyi lus bsgoms pas/ dngos po dang mtshan ma rnam rtog thams cad bde stong gi nyams su 'byung ste/ bar do longs sku thob/ 'o na rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su 'char ba'i nyams de bar dor cang thos sam byas pa la/ de yang skye lugs dang sbyar na/ gnyid mthug pos non pa'i dus su/ gtam la sogs pa smra 'phro la yang*/ rang dbang med par tshogs drug 'gags nas/ gnyid mthug por 'gro'o// de nas rmi lam mang po zing gis 'byung*/

de la der shes pas/ zag med kyi bde ba phril gyis skye'o// de bzhin du/ 'chi ba'i dus su/ rang dbang med par 'byung ba bzhi gcig la thim nas 'chi/ de yang sgyu ma lta bu'i lus len te/ rmi lam la der ngo shes pas/ sgyu lus la sgyu lus su shes pa 'byung*/ de bzhin du/ rmi (8ba)lam ngo shes pas/ zag med kyi bde ba skye ba bzhin du/ sgyu lus ngo shes pas kyang*/ de ltar skye'o// der bde ba skye ba la bsgoms pas sngar gyi 'byung ba'i lus kyi sgom pa dang mi 'dra ste/ yid kyi lus bsgoms pas/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma ltar rtogs nas bar dor longs sku thob bo// gdams pa zab mo gsang bar bya'o/// / 'od gsal gyi gdams pa lags/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyid 'od gsal du gzhug pa'i man ngag la/ gnyid 'od gsal du gzhug snyam pa'i dran pa dang*/ 'dun pas lus ci bder nyal lo// rang gi snying gar pad ma 'dab ma bzhi la a nu ta ra dgod/ dbus su hūṃ bkod la shes pa gtad pa'am/ yang na/ hūṃ gcig pu la shes pa gtad la/ gnyid la thum 'gro ba dang bde stong du lhan gyis btang*/ de'i rgyun 'od gsal ma shor bar bya/ gnyid sad dus na yang sngar bzhin bsgom/ bde stong du lhan lhan sgom 'phro la gnyid du ci 'gro bya/ song bas 'od gsal sgom 'phro 'ong*/ de nas/ nyin par gyi dus su yang*/ byug pa la sogs pa gnyid che ba'i thabs bya/ sgom pa'i sar gdan mthug po dang gos dro ba la sogs pas lus ci bder nyal/ dran pa dang 'dun pas 'od gsal sgom/ de'i 'phro la gnyid du btang la/ de'i rgyun ma shor ba bya/ gnyid log pa'i rgyun 'od gsal du ci 'gro bya'o// de nub nyal khar yang sngar bzhin bsgom/ de ltar nyin mtshan du bsgoms pas/ gnyid log ma log la khyad med na 'od gsal goms pa yin/ 'dir rmi lam (9na)'gal rkyen yin la/ rmi lam gyi dus su mthun rkyen no// 'dis kyang sems kyi ngo bo 'tshol ba yin gsung ngo*//

༈ // de kho na nyid sgom pa'i gdams pa lags/ na mo gu ru/ de kho na nyid sgom pa ni/ spros pa dang bral ba yin/ nyin mtshan kun tu chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bsgoms pas/ mnyam bzhag gi dus su nam mkha' stong pa'i dkyil nas nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ gsal la rtog pa med pa/ snang la rang bzhin med par shes/ rjes thob kyi dus su/ snang ba thams cad sgyu mar 'char/ snang ba yang ngos bzung med/ de lta bur rtogs na/ 'byung ba lnga'i lus 'dis/ 'ja' tshon lta bur snang la rang bzhin med par sangs rgyas/ mi gnas par mya ngan las 'das par sangs rgyas/ yang dag pa'i sangs rgyas yin/ sku gnyis rang shar longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skus sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' la chos ston/ sprul pa'i skus sems can gang la gang 'dul bde ba'i skur sprul nas chos ston/ bskyed rim 'ba' zhig bsgoms pas 'tshang mi rgya/ sa brgyad par slebs kyang*/ rdzogs rim ma rtogs kyi bar du dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten dgos/ rdzogs rim 'ba' zhig bsgoms pas sangs rgya ba yin/ gzugs sku rnam gnyis mi 'char/ 'byung ba'i lus 'dis bsgribs pas/ mnyam rjes med kyang*/ lus 'di ma bor tshun chad 'tshang rgya mi nus/ lus 'di bor nas/ ye shes zang thal du sangs rgya'o// ༈ / sku bzhi rang chas ma zhes bya ba lags so// na mo gu ru/ sems dngos po'i gnas lugs ma shes na/ bsgom rgyu don ngo mi shes/ de la sems kyi gnas lugs ni/ gsal ba'i dpe bum pa nang gi mar me lta bu rang rig rang gsal ba de zag pa med pa'i bde ba yin/ gsal ba dang zag pa med pa'i bde ba gnyis dbyer med/ stong (9ba)pa nyid spros bral 'dus ma byas nam mkha' lta bu/ rang rig rang gsal sprul pa'i sku/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ gsal ba dang zag med kyi bde ba gnyis dbyer med pa stong nyid spros bral 'dus ma byas chos kyi sku'o// sems dngos po'i gnas lugs la sku bzhi rang chas su gnas pa'o/

༈ / 'chi ka'i man ngag lags so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'od gsal la 'chi ka'i man ngag ni/ 'chi ba'i dus su glo g.yas pa phab la/ 'chi ka ma'i 'od gsal zin par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu btang*/ tha mal pa dang 'chi kar shes pa lte bar gnas pa yin pas/ yul lte bar rtsa pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi la/ a nu ra ta ra'i yi ge bzhi/ dbus su a dang bcas pa bsam la/ dang po mdun gyi a la shes pa gtad/ des sa chu la thim pas/ nad g.yog pas bltas pas/ gdong pa la sa gos pa dang*/ sna zhom pa dang*/ rna ba chag pa dang*/ lus zungs mi thub pa 'byung*/ 'chi ba po rang la snang ba 'di 'od sprin gyi rnam pa lta bu lang long du 'byung*/ mdun gyi a/ g.yas kyi nu la bsdu ba la sogs pa/ gzhan rnams la'ang shes par bya'o// de la g.yas kyi a nu la shes pa gtad de/ chu me la thim pas/ nad g.yog pas bltas pas/ kha chu dang sna chu thengs gcig 'ong*/ de nas sing gis skams nas 'gro/ 'chi ba po rang la/ snang ba 'di du ba'i rnam pa lta bu 'byung*/ de nas/ rgyab kyi ta la shes pa gtad de/ me rlung la thim pa'i rtags su/ nad g.yog pas bltas pas/ so tham/ lce la thig le nag po 'ong*/ lus kyi drod 'chor ba 'byung*/ 'chi ba po rang la/ snang ba 'di srin bu me khyer tsam las/ ches mi gsal ba 'byung*/ de nas/ g.yon gyi ra la shes pa gtad de/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pa'i rtags su/ nad g.yog pas bltas pas/ shi 'phras byed/ mig gyen la zlog /(10na)dbugs sho ba 'byung ste/ dbugs phyir 'gro ba yang sgra ngar ngar po// nang du 'jug pa yang sgra ngar ngar po 'ong zhing*/ dbugs 'byung shin tu rngub dka' ba 'ong*/ 'chi ba po rang la snang ba 'di mar me'i rnam pa 'od gsal ba cig 'byung ste/ skad cig ma'o// de nas/ dbus kyi a la shes pa gtad de/ rnam par shes pa sna tshogs pa la/ de snang ba rags pa/ de phra ba la/ de shin tu phra ba la/ de 'od gsal la thim pas/ 'od gsal ba de bde stong gi nyams su myong ba 'byung ngo*// de yang*/

sems ni/ 'chi ba 'od gsal stong pa chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin du nyams su myong ba dang*/ 'byung ba lnga'i rim gyis bsdus nas/ rnam par shes pa la thim/ rnam par shes pa snang mched thob gsum rim gyis 'od gsal la thim pas/ de nyid du chos sku thob bo// sngar gyi gnyid 'od gsal du nyams su myong ba yod pa dang*/ 'dir de ltar bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis/ de'i dus su chos sku nyams su myong ba 'byung ste/ gang ltar 'gro rung mi 'gro rung chos sku thob bo// ༈ // bar do'i man ngag lags// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bar do la gsum yin/ dang po snang ba gsum gyis bsgoms pa goms pa'i sgo nas 'od gsal ngos gzung ba dang*/ gnyis pa sgyu lus ngo shes pa'i sgo nas zung 'jug ngos bzung ba dang*/ gsum pa dran pa dang 'dun pa'i sgo nas mngal gyi skye gnas dgag pa'o// 'od gsal la gsum las/ skye ba 'di la 'bad rtsol gyis bsgoms pa goms pa'i 'od gsal dang*/ sems snang ba gsum gyi skabs su/ bsam gtan gyi 'od gsal dang*/ srid pa bar dor 'char ba rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal lo// des sems can kun la ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa yin/ de la dang po lus len tsa na yang 'byung ba bzhi las (10ba)grub/ da lta 'byung bzhi'i ngo bor gnas/ tha ma 'chi ba'i tshe 'byung ba bzhi rim gyis thim pa ni/ sa chu la thim pa la sogs pa'o// de'i tshe 'byung ba bzhi rim gyis thim pa'o// rnam par shes pa snang ba la thim pa'i tshe stong pa ste/ nang rtags du ba lta bu phyi rtags zla ba shar ba lta bu'o// snang ba'i go ba ni/ rtsa phran rags pa'i rlung rtsa gnyis por tshud/ rtsa gnyis po'i rlung dhū tir bag tsam tshud pas/ rnam rtog gi rlung 'gag /phyi rtags zla ba la sogs pa je mi gsal la song*/ nang rtags du ba la sogs pa gsal/ de ltar 'gag pas/ zhes sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa sum cu so gsum 'gags pas/ sems kyi ngo bo bag tsam gsal bas na snang ba zhes bya/

ye shes dang po bag tsam gsal ba 'ong*/ snang ba mched pa la thim pa'i tshe/ shin tu stong pa ste/ nang rtags srin bu me khyer ba lta bu/ phyi rtags nyi ma shar ba lta bu dmar ding nge ba 'ong*/ mched pa'i go ba ni/ rlung dhū tir cher zhugs pas/ 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gags pas/ sems kyi ngo bo gsal ba de cher song bas mched pa zhes bya/ ye shes gsal ye re ba 'ong*/ mched pa thob pa la thim pa'i tshe stong pa chen po ste/ nang rtags mar me lta bu/ phyi rtags mun sros pa lta bu nag thom pa 'ong*/ thob pa'i go ba ni rtsa rlung dhū tir rang bzhin gyis tshud pas/ ma rig pa skad cig ma bdun 'gags pas/ sems kyi ngo bo gsal lhag gis shar bas na/ thob pa zhes bya'o// ye shes gsal sing nge ba 'ong*/ de gsum shar tsa na/ sgom gyi dbang du byas na zhi gnas yin/ 'od gsal gyi dbang du byas na/ bsam gtan gyi 'od gsal yin/ thob pa 'od gsal la thim pa'i tshe/ thams cad stong pa yin/ (11na)phyi rtags skya rengs shar ba lta bu/ nang rtags sprin med pa'i nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bu'o// phyi nang gnyis su byas kyang dbang po'i yul med/ shes pa'i nyams med/ bsam gtan gyi 'od gsal dang*/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal gcig tu 'dres tsa na/ mi rtog pa'i ye shes shes bya/ sgom gyi dbang du byas na lhag mthong zhes bya/ 'od gsal gyi dbang du byas na rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal zhes bya/ de tsa na goms pa shas cher byas pas/ 'od gsal ba ni rgyun par gnas// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// lus rgya dang bral tsam gyis yar gyi mtshams med ces bya/ dbang po rab tshe 'di la sangs rgya ba yin pas/ gzugs sku gnyis gzhan snang la 'char/ bar do dang po'i 'od gsal ngos bzung ba'o// sgyu lus ngos bzung ba la gnyis yin/ ma dag pa'i sgyu lus ngos bzung ba dang*/ dag pa'i sgyu lus ngos bzung ba'o// ma dag pa'i sgyu lus ni/

lam la sbyang ba'i dbang du byas na/ zhag bdun phrag dang po'i zhag phyed dang bzhi tshun chad snga ma ma shi ba'i gong gi lus kyi snang ba dang mi 'bral la/ de phan chad phyi ma lus gang len pa'i lus su snang*/ shi bar shes/ de'i mtshan nyid ni/ sngon byung srid pa'i sha gzugs can// dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu// las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan// rigs mthun lha mig dag pas mthong*// srid pa phyi ma'o// sha tshugs can las kyi stobs kyis nam mkha' dag pa la sprin 'ong ba dang*/ chu las nya 'phar ba bzhin bar do'i snang ba las mngal du 'jug ste/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'gyur ro// de kun la/ ma dag pa'i sgyu lus shes bya/ de ngos mi zin/ (11ba)gnyis pa dag pa'i sgyu lus ni/ lam sbyang ba'i dbang du byas na bsgom pa'i rten rang lha'i sku sgyu ma'am/ 'ja' tshon lta bu cig ngos 'dzin pa yin/ dag pa'i sgyu lus shes bya/ zung 'jug gi sku zhes bya/ lus gcig gis du ma la khyab pa ste du ma 'byung*/ zung 'jug la gnyis/ slob pa'i zung 'jug dang*/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug go /slob pa'i zung 'jug sgom pa'i rten yi dam gyi lha sgyu ma lta bu dang ma bral bar/ 'od gsal sgom pa brtan par byed pa yin/ 'od gsal gyi sems bag chags sbyang du yod pa'i dus su/ rnam rtog thams cad dang bag chags thams cad 'od gsal gyi mes bsregs nas/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed med par gsal ba rab kyi mthar phyin pa 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu gyur tsa na/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ces bya/ 'bras bu thob pa'o// de la gnas pa ni/ ye shes kyi sku zhes bya'o// dbang po 'bring bar dor sangs rgya ba yin/ gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis gzhan snang la 'char/ bar do gnyis pa sgyu lus ngos bzung ba'o// mngal gyi sgo dgag pa ni bzhi yin/ dran pa dang 'dun pas dgag pa dang*/ bla ma yab yum gyis dgag pa dang*/ yi dam gyi lhas dgag pa dang*/

sgyu ma lta bu'i dgag pa'o// dran pa dang 'dun pas dgag pa ni/ bar do'i mig lam du rig drug gi rnam pa 'ong*/ de dag sdug bsngal du shes pa'o// sngar yang sdug bsngal du ma shes par chags pas 'khyams/ de yang mngal du zhugs te skye ba blangs na/ sdug bsngal de lta bu nyams su myong bar 'gyur snyam du bsam pas/ mngal du 'jug pa'i blo ldog la/ rang lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bu la sgom pa'i rten byas la/ 'od gsal sgom snyam pa'i 'dun pa (12na)bya'o// gnyis pa bla ma yab yum gyis dgag pa ni/ rigs drug tu skye ba'i rgyu chags sdang yin pas/ pha ni bla mar bsgom/ ma ni bla ma'i yum du bsgom/ bla ma'i yum la chags pa mi skye/ zhe sdang dang mig ser bzlog la/ bla ma yab yum du bsams la dad gus bya'o// dbang dang gdams ngag zhu'o// rang lha sku sgyu ma lta bu la sgom pa'i rten byas la/ bde stong dbyer med bsgom pa'o// gsum pa yi dam lhas dgag pa ni/ pha ma snyoms 'jug byed pa'i dus su/ pha he ru ka la sogs pa dang*/ ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sogs par bsgoms pas/ chags sdang mi skye'o// chags sdang gi blo ldog la/ rang lha sku sgyu ma lta bu la sgom pa'i rten byas la 'od gsal bsgom/ bzhi pa sgyu ma lta bus dgag pa ni/ sgyu ma lta bu/ rmi lam lta bu/ rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa/ sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan/ chu nang gi zla ba dang*/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang khyad ci yod snyam du bsam la/ chags sdang gi blo ldog la/ rang lha sku sgyu ma lta bu la rten byas la 'od gsal bsgom/ bdun phrag dang por skye ba khegs na/ gnyis pa la sogs pa la tshegs med pas/ zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgu tshun chad lam sbyangs nas sangs rgya'o// bar do gsum pa'o// gal te sangs rgya ma nus nas skye ba len par 'dug na/ mngal bdam pa ni/ rang lha sku sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ ma bral bar gzhan don la mthu yod pa dang*/

rang dbang can du lus blangs te/ tshangs pa'am/ brgya byin nam/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por skyes nas lam sbyangs nas sangs rgya ba ni dbang po tha ma'o// yang na rang gi don la brtan pa thob nas rang dbang can du/ gzhan don (12ba)la mthu yod pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la sogs par skye ba blangs nas sems can gyi don bya'o// bar do'i gdams pa zab mo'o// ༈ //

'pho ba'i man ngag lags so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'pho ba la don gsum la sbyangs te 'pho ba'o// de la gnyis las/ sngon du rlung sbyangs pa'i bum pa can la bslabs pas/ rab brgya rtsa brgyad/ 'bring bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ tha ma sum cu rtsa ba drug khegs nas 'pho ba sbyong*/ de mi khegs na rlung sbyang ngo*// de nas 'pho ba sbyong ba ni/ lus gnad bcos nas/ sgo dgu yi ge dgus bkag /lte ba na sems kyi rgyal po yi ge a gnas pa de/ spyi bo nas rtsa ba thag gi rnam pa lta bus btags nas yod par bsam/ de nas rlung nang du bsdam/ hik+ka nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas/ a de yar la spyi bo'i klad pa'i steng du thod pa'i 'og tu yer gyis yong bar bsam/ de nas/ rlung khug pa cig dal bus rgyur gzhug /de nas/ yang rlung nang du bzhag la/ ka hika nyi shu rtsa gcig khron pa'i nang gi sbyang rtsi'u btang ba bzhin log song nas lte bar/ gis mar dbab/ de nas ngal bso la/ yang thun mtshams su spyi bor mi bzhag /de ltar byas pas/ 'byongs pa'i tshad/ dpral ba dang*/ spyi bo tsha tsag tsag pa 'ong*/ lha cher 'gro /de ltar 'pho ba la nyi shu tsam byas nas sbyangs na/ lo drug cu lon yang 'pho btub pa yin gsung*/ de ltar 'pho ba sbyangs nas/ 'chi rtags byung na/ 'chi slu bya zhing*/ de kyang mi phan na 'pho ba bya ste/ byed lugs 'pho ba dngos gzhi na gsal lo// ༈ // rmi lam gyi 'byams sel lags// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'byams pa bcu gnyis ni/ rtsa ba bzhi yin gsung ngo*// de la 'khrul 'byams dang*/ sngar gyi rgyun la 'byams pa dang*/ (13na)sad 'byams dang*/ brjed 'byams dang bzhi'o// 'khrul 'byams ni/ ma zin pa yin/ de la rlung drag po bzung gin byas pas zin te 'ong*/ rgyun 'byams ni/ rmi lam zin par bya'o// de rang 'byams pa'o// de la zin par bya'o snyam nas sbyangs pas zin gsung*/ sad 'byams ni/ gnyid ma sad par zin 'phro la sad pa yin snyam nas 'phro bcad pa 'ong gsung*/

de la gnyid ma sad par sbyang snyam pa'o// des zin gsung*/ brjed 'byams ni/ thengs cig zin yang brjed pa 'ong*/ de la ma brjed par bya'o snyam pas mi brjed gsung*/ bcu gnyis su phye na 'khrul 'byams la dbye ba med gsung*/ sngar gyi rgyun 'byams la bzhi las/ bdag la brten nas 'byams pa ni/ bdag shes nas/ rmi lam du shes par bya ba'i bar rgyun dang ma bral bar bya'o// gzhan la brten nas 'byams pa ni/ mi gzhan du snang yang shes par bya'o snyam zhing sbyang ba'o// gnyid 'byams ni/ gnyid du song nas so// rmi lam la brten nas 'byams pa ni/ ba lang la sogs pa snang yang shes par bya'o snyam zhing sbyong bar mi byed pa'o// de ltar bzhi po yang dbye ba de bcu gnyis so// bcos lugs gong gi bzhi po las med gsung*/ rmi lam la gnyis yod de/ lam du 'gro ba dang mi 'gro ba'o// lam du mi 'gro ba ni/ rang dbang med pa dang*/ 'khrul pa dang phyin ci log pa dang*/ ma dag pa'o// lam du 'gro ba ni/ rang dbang can dang*/ ma 'khrul ba dang*/ phyin ci ma log pa dang*/ dag pa'o// dran pa dang*/ sgyu mar shes pa dang*/ rmi lam la rmi lam du shes par bya/ gnyid ma log pa'i dus su yang*/ snang srid sgyu mar shes par bya// sgyu ma dngos ni rmi lam yin// gang gis rtag tu (13ba)bsgoms gyur na// rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du 'gyur// rmi lam zin pa'i thabs la/ rlung bum pa can thun re bsgoms la/ gnyid thum gyis 'gro khar rlung lte bar bcug la nyal lo// ༈ // bar do sku bzhi'i ngo sprod lags so// bla ma grub thob rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// man ngag 'di la don bzhi ste/ ma bcos pa'i ye shes ngos bzung ba dang*/ ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzhag pa dang*/ snga phyi gcig tu bsre ba'i man ngag gis dngos po thams cad gcig tu ro mnyam pa dang*/ dngos po thams cad ro mnyam pas 'bras bu nam mkha' ltar bstan pa'o// de la bar do'i man ngag gis ma bcos pa'i ye shes ngos bzung ba la gsum ste/

shes pa snga phyi'i bar do dang*/ gnyid dang rmi lam gyi bar do dang*/ 'chi ba'i bar do'o// de la shes pa snga phyi'i bar do ni/ dper na/ dgun zla 'bring po'i nya la/ dbyar gyi sprin dang na bun ni yal/ dgun gyi rlung dang tshub ma ni ma langs/ nyi ma ri rtse la shar ba'i dus su/ nam mkha'i dkyil du bltas tsa na/ gsal sing nge ba gcig yod pa dang 'dra bar/ shes pa snga ma'i rtog pa ni 'gags/ dran rtog thams cad ni brjed/ phyi ma'i rtog pa ni ma langs pa'i dus su shes pa gsal sing ba rtog med cig 'byung ba'o// gnyid dang rmi lam gyi bar do ni/ gnyid nyal ba'i dus su/ gnyid ni ma log /phyi'i rtog pa ni 'gag pa'i dus su/ shes pa ma bcos pa'i gsal le sing nge ba'i rtog med 'byung ba'o// 'chi kha'i bar do ni/ 'byung ba bzhi rim gyis thim nas/ mthar rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim pa'i dus su/ 'jig rten 'di'i rnam rtog ni 'gags/ phyi ma'i rnam rtog ma langs pa'i bar der/ ma bcos pa'i ye shes gnyug ma gsal sing nge ba'i rtog med (14na)cig 'byung ngo*// ma bcos pa'i rang la gnas par bya ba ni/ ye shes ngos zin nas/ de la rgyun du gnas pa'o// snga phyi gcig tu bsre ba'i man ngag gi dngos po thams cad ro mnyam pa ni/ rmi lam gyi shes pa dang snga phyi gcig tu bsre ste/ ro mnyam du bsgom/ 'jig rten 'di dang phyi ma bsre ste/ ro mnyam du bsgom/ 'khor 'das thams cad ro mnyam du bsgom pa'o// dngos po thams cad ro mnyam pas 'bras bu nam mkha' ltar bstan pa ni/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad kyi sku bde ba chen po yid la mi byed par rtogs pas sangs rgyas so// bar do rnam gsum dang*/ sku bzhi ngo sprad pa'i gdams ngag go /bskyed rim bsgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ sprul sku thob/ 'od gsal bsgoms pa'i dgos pa ni/ chos sku thob/ zung 'jug sgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob/

sku gsum dbyer med du rtogs pa ni/ bde ba chen po'i sku'o// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku bzhi dang ldan pa'o// rje tai lo pas/ dpal nā ro pa la gnang ba'o// ༈ // lus gnad kyi man ngag lags so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gdams ngag nyams su len pa'i dus na 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ dang po lus kyi gnas lugs shes par bya ba ni/ rkang pa re'u mig ltar bsnol/ sgal pa chu shing ltar bsrang*/ lte ba'i 'og tu mnyam bzhag byas la/ lus gnas lugs su bzhag pa'o// de nas lus la rtsa rnam pa gsum gnas te/ rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i mdor mnyam bzhag byas nas/ lte ba'i thad kar rtsa dbu ma'i nang du a dmar po shad lta bu cig bsam par bya'o// de nas rtsol sgrub drag tu bya ste/ de ltar bla ma'i man ngag 'di ni/ yang dang yang du nyams su blangs pas/ lus la bde drod shugs kyis (14ba)'byung la/ sems la 'od gsal ngang gis 'char ro// bla ma chen po nā ro pa'i// thabs lam khyad du 'phags pa 'di// skal ldan las can ma yin pa// gzhan la byin na dam tshig nyams// ༄༅// chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ phyag chen go cha gnyis kyi man ngag bzhugs so// bla ma mnyam med rin po che// sku bzhi dbyer med lhun gyis grub// skal ldan sangs rgyas ngo sprod pa'i// rtogs ldan rin po che la 'dud// tshe 'di la ltos thag bcad nas sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la chos rnam pa gnyis te/ spang bya dang*/ blang bya'o/ de la spang bya ni/ rgyu'i rkyen gyi dus na zhen na/ bdag po'i rkyen gyi dus na/ log pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad/ dmigs pa'i rkyen gyi dus na ma 'khrul/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen gyi dus na/ re dwogs su gyur pa las 'khor bar snang ba'o// blang bya ni/ rgyu'i rkyen gyi dus na ma zhen/ bdag po'i rkyen gyi dus na/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad/ dmigs pa'i rkyen gyi dus na ma 'khrul/

de ma thag pa'i rkyen gyi dus na/ re dwogs med pa las 'khor ba chos skur snang ba'o// rtogs te sangs rgyas/ de lta bu'i don rtogs par byed pa la bla ma bsten dgos/ de la gnyis te/ rtog pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'char ba dang*/ gang zag dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'char ba'o// dang po ni/ rtog pa sku drin can du shes pas/ rtog pa lam du 'khyer ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ mi 'tsham pa byung yang*/ mi bzod pa med pa/ grogs su 'gro ba/ 'gal ba sgyur nus pa/ gsol ba 'debs nus pa/ rang gi shes pa mdung nam mkha' la bskor ba dang 'dra/ ma 'khrul pa/ shes rab kyi go 'byed nus pa'o// de yang*/ lhan cig skyes sbyor ni go cha gnyis kyis lam du 'khyer te/ lta ba'i go cha dang*/ shes rab kyi go cha'o// dang po ni/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ byed pa'i (15na)mtshan nyid dang*/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ ngo bo'i mtshan nyid do// shes pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ shes rab kyis sems kyi mtshan nyid shes par bya ste/ skye ba med pa chos sku/ 'gag pa med pa longs sku/ gnas pa med pa sprul skur shes par bya'o// sku gsum rtogs pa'i blo la sna tshogs brjod du med pa'o// ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral ba blo'i yul las 'das pa ste/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o// sems kyi mtshan nyid sku bzhir ngos 'dzin pa de shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin no// khyad par gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rnam rtog byung tshad sems nyid yin pas mi spong bar sku bzhir shes par bya'o// byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ rtogs pa sku bzhi yin yang*/ byed pa po med par chos nyid sgyu ma lta bur 'gro yi/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rtogs pa gdod ma nas sku bzhir lhun gyi grub pa yin te/ de ltar chos thams cad mtshan nyid bzhi las ma 'das par shes pa dang*/ lta ba'i go cha'o// shes rab kyi go cha ni/ rdo rje skyil krung bca'/ lus bsrang*/ mig sna rtser phab/ mnyam pa nyid kyi phyag rgya byas la/

sems can gyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir/ zab mo'i don 'di bsgom par bya'o// snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o// shes rab mig ni sems la lta/ tshig tu/ skye ba med pa/ 'gag pa med pa/ gnas pa med pa/ sems dngos po med pa'o// zhes lan gsum brjod pa ni thos pa'i shes rab bo// de'i don ni/ sems de ye nas skye ma myong*/ nam zhig 'gags na yang 'gags te 'gags pa'i rgyu med/ gnas na yang dus ci tsam gnas te/ skye 'gag med pa nyid kyis gnas pa med/ dngos po med de/ dbyibs dang kha dog tu grub rgyu med pas/ dngos po ngos bzung thams cad dang bral bar nges shes skyes (15ba)pa ni/ bsam byung gi shes rab bo// thob pa'i don de shes te/ nam mkha' ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba/ rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bu la sems pa ni/ sgom byung gi shes rab bo// de yang*/ yengs pa la rnam rtog byung na ji ltar bya snyam na/ blos mi spong bar snying du sdug par blta/ dgos par bya/ sku drin che bar blta/ med du mi rung bar blta/ de ci ste zhe na/ yon tan thams cad kho rang la rang chas su yod pas/ ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa yin pas so// de ltar rtog pa lam du khyer bas/ rtog pa rang zhi rang dag tu 'gro/ dper na/ mtsho la 'khyag pa zhu ba'am/ nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa bzhin du song*/ yon tan kyi chos su gyur pa thams cad 'gag pa med par shugs kyis 'byung ba de/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu yin par shes par byas la/ gong nas gong du shes rab kyi rtsal sbyang ngo*// de lta bu de/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor/ spros bral gyi rnal 'byor/ du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor/ mnyam bzhag chen po'i rnal 'byor yin no// tha mal gyi shes pa bya ba/ rtog pa lam du 'khyer ba'i gdams ngag go/ ༈ //bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i zhal nas/ lhan cig skyes sbyor sgom pa'i dus na/

phyi lta ba'i go cha dang*/ nang shes rab kyi go cha gnyis yin gsung*/ phyi lta ba'i go cha ni/ dkar po'i chos spyod rgyun mi gcod/ sdig pa phra zhing phra la 'dzem pa'o// shes rab kya go cha ni/ rang gi shes pa la bltas pa'i dus na/ zhi gnas bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin byung ba la yon tan du mi blta/ de ma byung ba la skyon du mi lta bar/ shes pa ma yengs par bsgoms pas ci zhig tsa na/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad skye med kyi grogs su 'char ba yin gsung*/ 'jog pa yin/ ma yengs pa'i dus su rnam rtog ye mi 'ong*/ (16na)shes pa yengs pa'i dus su rnam rtog cig yer gyis 'ong*/ de byung ba'i dus su/ de la bltas pas/ rnam rtog de dang po ma skyes/ bar du mi gnas/ tha mar mi 'gag ste/ dngos po'am/ ngo bo nyid dam/ ngos bzung mtha' dag dang bral bar 'dug pa bya ba yin/ 'o de rang gi sems su 'dug /sems skye med stong pa nyid du 'dug /skye med stong nyid de chos skur 'dug snyam pa de yang sems yin gsung*/ de las med/ 'bad nas sgoms gsung*/// /bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas la re ba med de/ sku gsum rang la yod pa'i phyir ro// 'khor ba la dog pa med de/ spang du med cing shes rab kyi bud shing yin pa'i phyir ro// bla ma lcags ri ba'i man ngag yin te/ phrad 'joms/ phyi bsnyag /med sprul bya ba yin te/ sgom chen pa de sgom pa'i dus su/ rnam rtog byung ba la phrad 'joms/ rtog pa byung ma thag skye med du chod pa yin/ phyi bsnyags pa ni/ rtog pa de dang po gang nas byung bltas pas/ sems las byung*/ mthar yang sems la thim/ sems dang gnyis med tha mi dad/ sems skye med du shes pa de phyi bsnyags pa bya ba yin gsung*/ med sprul pa ni/ sems la lci ba de bas bde bsams nas/ mi bde ba de sprul pa yin te/ de rnam par rtog pa yin te/ sems skye med chos kyi sku yin gsung*/

dpe gsum ni/ nags la me mched pa dang 'dra ste/ rlung la sogs pa ci ltar che ba ltar grogs su 'gro /de bzhin du/ rnam rtog ci skyes shes rab kyi grogs su 'gro gsung*/ chu la kha ba bab pa dang 'dra ste/ kha ba babs tshad chur ro gcig tu 'gro/ de bzhin du/ rnam rtog skyes ma thag lhan cig skyes par ro gcig pa'o// sngar 'dris kyi mi (16ba)mthong ba dang 'dra ste/ yin min rtog dpyod bya mi dgos par ngo shes/ de bzhin du/ rnam rtog la rtog dpyod bya mi dgos par/ skye med du ngo shes gsung*/ de dge bshes lcags ri ba'i 'khyer lugs yin gsung*/// / lhan cig skyes sbyor ni/ gang dang skyes sbyor zhe na/ rig pa dang*/ stong pa lhan cig skyes/ de rang dang tha dad 'dug pa lta bu ma yin te/ rig pa gsal ba bde ba stong nyid du sbyor bas na/ lhan gcig skyes sbyor ro// de la gnyis/ lta ba'i go cha dang*/ shes rab kyi go cha'o// de la lta ba'i go cha ni/ mtshan nyid rnam pa bzhi ste/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ byed pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid do// de la shes pa ni/ dang po gnas kyang ma skyes/ bar du gar yang mi gnas/ tha ma gar yang mi 'gag /kha dog dang*/ dbyibs su ma grub ste spros pa dang bral ba/ ngos bzung dang bral ba med pa ma yin pa'i don te/ skye ba med pa chos sku/ 'gag pa med pa longs sku/ gnas pa med pa sprul sku/ ngo bo ngos bzung med pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o// sku bzhir thag chod pa ni shes pa'i mtshan nyid de/ med pa ma yin te/ gsal la go ma 'gags pa cig tu rgyun chad med par/ dus thams cad du gnas pa ni shes pa'i mtshan nyid do// khyad par ni/ shes pa ci yang ma yin pa de nyid/ rtog pa sna tshogs su 'char/ shar ba de nyid ci yang ma yin pa'i ngo bor

rnam rtog gis ma sgribs pa'i shes pa lhang nge gsal ba/ gnas pa ni/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid do// byed pa ni/ chos nyid rtog pa sna tshogs su (17na)shar yang*/ byed pa po med la/ rtog pa sna tshogs chos nyid du shar yang*/ byed pa po med pa ni mtshan nyid do// de lta bu'i don dbyings rnam par dag pa nyams su myong ba ni/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid do// shes rab kyi go cha ni/ thos skye med la sogs pa/ pa'i shes rab tshig tu lan gsum brjod/ bsam pa'i shes rab/ de'i don go bar bya/ sgom pa'i shes rab ni/ rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi ste/ rig pa'i ngo bo la/ ma yengs par cir snang ci dran sems su shes par bya/ 'dug pa rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor/ rtse gcig la rtogs pa gyur na/ phrad 'dzom/ phyi bsnyag /de ltar rtog pa lam du longs nas/ rtog pa de med du mi rung bar 'gyur/ bka' drin che bar 'gyur ba ni spros bral gyi rnal 'byor/ de nyid kyi ngang lam yengs par byas pas/ phyi'i snang ba ban bun tsam du chod tsa na/ du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor/ de la goms par byas pas rig pa gcer bu 'ba' zhig tu rnam rtog gis gos pa med pa/ gyur nas/ de tsa na goms pa mtha' phyin nas chos sku thob pa ni/ sgom med kyi rnal 'byor ro// de rnams kyis/ lta ba'i go chas shes rab kyi go cha bstan pa'o// bla ma dam pa'i gdams pa nyams myong dang 'grogs pa'o// rnam par rtog pa thams cad sems yin/ sems skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i ngang la 'jog pa ni ma yengs pa'o// ༈ // chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung sgros/ slob dpon ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka'i dgongs pa'o// na mo gu ru/ slob dpon ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka'i dgongs pa bde ba chen po'i man ngag ni/ ngo bo gsum/ dam tshig bzhi/ gol sa gsum/ bzhag thabs bzhi'o// de la ngo bo gsum ni/ (17ba)dang po rtsol sgrub med pa/ gnyis pa ma bcos pa/ gsum pa byung tshor thams cad rang gi sems su shes pa'o// dam tshig bzhi ni/

nyon mongs pa spang du med de/ rang gi sems yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyen po rten du med de/ sems gnyis su med pa'i phyir ro// 'bras bu la re ba med de/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir ro// 'khor ba la dogs pa med de/ de bzhin nyid sgom du med pa'i phyir ro// gol sa gsum ni sangs rgyas la re na gol/ 'khor ba la dogs pa na gol/ dngos por snang ba 'di la zhen na gol ba yin no// bzhag thabs bzhi ni/ chu ma rnyogs na dwangs pa bzhin du/ tshul ma bcos par bzhag go /nyi ma sprin gyis ma bsgribs pa bzhin du/ tshogs drug mi dgag pa rang lugs su bzhag go /dus dang spyod lam thams cad du ma yengs par bzhag go /ḍoṃ bhi ba'i dgongs pa'o// ༈ // chos rje dwags po lha rje'i lta sgom yang dag gi man ngag go / bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rtogs ldan cig dang*/ slob ma skal ldan cig phrad na/ bla ma des/ smin par byed pa dbang rnam pa bzhi byas nas/ grol bar byed pa'i thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis bskyed rim ni lha sku sgyu ma lta bur sgom pa dang*/ rtsa rlung sgom pa dang*/ spros pa dang bcas pa'i rdzogs rim kyang yin gsung*/ rdzogs rim ni/ 'od gsal sems kyi stong nyid yin te/ de ltar bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pas yon tan lhun grub tu 'byung ngo*// slob pa yin/ de yang mngon par sgom pa las 'byung gsung*/ lus bde ba dang*/ sems bde ba yang 'ong ste/ nang du rtags rnam pa lnga 'char/ phyir yang phan yon brgyad 'byung ste/ rtags dang po du ba lta bu byung nas snang ba 'gags te rlung dhū tir tshud pa yin te/ zhi gnas (18na)mthar phyin skyes pa'i rtags yin gsung*/ rtags gnyis pa shar dus snang ba nyams su myong ba yin te/ phyi'i snang ba 'di la mi zer/ sems kyis sems nyid nyams su myong ba bya ba yin/ rtags gsum pa byung dus gsal la mi rtog pa 'byung*/ sgom pa mthar thug yin/

rlung sems su tshud pa'i rtags yin/ rtags bzhi pa shar dus lta ba'i don dang*/ chos thams cad rig cing gsal ba dang*/ 'phrin las bzhi 'grub ste/ lta ba'i don bya ba ni/ sems nyid la blo nges pa'o// chos thams cad rig cing gsal ba ni/ 'khor 'das thams cad 'od gsal du shar ba'o// 'phrin las bzhi 'grub pa ni/ bzlas pa la sogs pa bya mi dgos par/ 'phrin las bzhi gang byed kyang tshegs med par 'grub bo// rlung 'od gsal du tshud pa'o// ye shes kyi rtags kyang 'byung ste/ lus 'ja' tshon nam 'od kyi gong bu la sogs par mthong ba 'ong ste/ ye shes kyi rtags bya ba yin gsung*/ lta ba dang lta byed med pa la stong nyid zer ba yin/ khams gsum las 'das shing*/ blo dang bral bas smon med zer ba yin no gsung*// rgyu lam 'bras bu gsum ni/ bskyed par byed pas na rgyu/ 'phel bar byed pas na lam/ rdzogs par byed pas na 'bras bu'o// de yang*/ mar gyi dbang du byas na rgyu ma rig pa/ lam sdig pa chung ngu las chen por 'phel ba/ 'bras bu ngan song gsum mo// yar gyi dbang du byas na/ pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ rgyu rig pa byang chub kyi sems/ lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug /yang na bslab pa gsum la byed/ dngos kyi rgyu rig pa byang chub kyi sems/ lam bskyed rdzogs/ 'bras bu sku gsum mo// tha mal gyi shes (18ba)pa/ ma bcos pa/ gnyug ma gsum las tha mal gyi shes pa ni/ dang po'i shes pa/ grub mtha' gzhan gyis blo ma bsgyur ba'o// ma bcos pa ni/ bcas bcos mi bya bar rang gar bzhag pa'o// gnyug ma ni/ de'i don skyes/ nyon mongs pa 'gag la/ rgyun chad med pa'i rnal 'byor pa la/ sems kyi 'dzin pa yod/ sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la ye shes kyi 'dzin pa yod/ 'dzin pa mtha' dag dang bral ba sangs rgyas yin/ rig pa'i ngo bo la ma yengs pa de nyid/ rgyun chad da lta nas med par 'dod pa de mi bden/

sangs rgyas la nyams myong yod ma myong*/ da lta 'dzin pa yod zer mod/ de sa bcu man chad la 'dzin pa yod/ rnal 'byor pa rab la/ rnam rtog skad cig ma/ 'bring la 'chol bar yod/ tha ma la mi rtog pa skad cig ma yin gsung*/// /mi rtog pa/ ye shes/ stong pa gsum las/ mi rtog pa ni/ rtog pa dang bral ba yin/ ye shes ni/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ye shes yod pa la bya/ stong pa ni/ bde stong ngos bzung dang bral ba la zer ba yin no/// /sems kyi mtshan nyid/ rang bzhin ngo bo gsum las/ mtshan nyid ni sna tshogs su snang ba'o// rang bzhin ni gsal la go ma 'gag pa'o// ngo bo ni bde ba nyams su myong ba'i ye shes so// gsang sngags kyi sgom pa ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs gsum byas nas/ bskyed rim sgom pa la gsum/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyis sgom pa ni/ skad cig mar lha'i skur wal gyis sgom pa'o// cho ga gsum gyis sgom pa ni/ he ru ka bsgom pa'i sems sngon du 'gro bas/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyi nang snod bcud (19na)yongs la bya ba/ de thams cad 'od dang lhar byas nas yang hūm̐ de la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ lha'i skur bsgom pa'i rim pa ni/ sgrub thabs las shes par bya'o// de ni lus lha'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa'o// sgrib pa ni gsum ka byang ste/ khyad par lus kyi byang ngo*// gsang sngags kyi bzlas pas/ ngag gi bden pa 'grub ste/ tshe 'dir smras pa gnyan pa dang*/ dgra bgegs la sogs pas mi tshugs/ phyis bzlas pa ma byas kyang nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// sgrib pa ni gsum ka byang ste khyad par ngag gi byang ngo*// yid chos nyid kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa ni gnyug ma'o// rtogs na dkar po chig thub ces bya ste/ sgrib pa ni gsum ka byang ngo*// bskyed rim gyi dgos pa ni/ dbang po 'bring dang*/ tha ma gnyis kyis tha mal gyi zhen pa ldog

/rab kyis zung 'jug gi rtogs pa 'byung*// bden pa mthong bar bshad/ tha mal gyi zhen pa/ 'jig rten gyi ming dang rus spangs te/ rigs ni rdo rje'i rigs/ ming ni he ru ka'o// zung 'jug gi rtog pa ni/ re zhig yid yul du/ sgyu ma lta bu btags pa tsam du snang ba las/ don la gnyis su med pas na'o// 'bring gis 'khor los sgyur rgyal thob ste/ rgyud las kyang rdo rje'i 'dzin pa'am/ yang na 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po thob/ ces bshad do// tha mas lha mi khyad par can thob/ rab kyis bden pa mthong ba'i gnad gang zhe na/ lha'i sku de bzung ba'i yul yin/ de skyed par byed pa 'dzin pa'i sems yin/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med du shes pas/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs pa bden pa mthong ba'o// 'bring gis sgyu mar nges/ tha mas mos pa byed/ rab kyis bden pa mthong ba'o// (19ba)bskyed rim kyi ngo bo lha/ nges tshig rim gyis 'byed/ dbye ba tha dad do// sgrib pa ni gsum las shes bya'i sgrib pa don ma rig pa yin/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ni 'dod chags la sogs pa'o// las kyi sgrib pa nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs nas/ mi dge ba bcu spyad pas 'bras bu 'byin pa de'o// de gsum spong ba la/ dge bshes bka' gdams pa kun/ sngon du gnyis po sbyangs pas/ shes sgrib zhor la byang gsung*/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ sngon du shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyong*/ de 'byongs na gnyis po sgrog rang brdal zhes bya/ ma 'byongs na sdong po yal ga bcad pa dang 'dra ste yang skye/ shes sgrib 'byongs na sdong po rtsa ba bcad pa dang 'dra ste skye rgyu med gsung*/ de gnyis ka bden/ dge bshes pa bden te/ las dang nyon mongs pa ma bral na sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs med/ bla ma bden te/ shes bya la ko long ma gsol na/ gnyis po zad kyang shes sgrib so skye'i dus na bag la nyal zhes bya/ chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin gnas/

yul dang bral nas snang gi /'phral du rnam smin mi 'byin/ de'i ngo bo ye shes yin te/ ye shes rgyu dge ba'i rang bzhin yin pas/ sa bon gdab bya 'debs byed med/ bag la nyal de las rnam shes la bya ste/ mdo las/ rnam par shes pa rnams ni zab cing phra// sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab// ces gsungs pas/ zab pa ni gting mi rnyed pa'o/ phra ba ni mi mthong ba'o/ de la bag la nyal gyi sa bon 'debs pa ni/ dper na/ rang gi gdong pa la tshon dkar nag gnyis byugs nas/ me long la bltas pas/ gdong pha gir shar ba de/ gdong pa pha gir 'phos pa ma yin/ gdong pa (20na)dngos min te/ med par ma song ba de bzhin du/ rnam shes bag chags kyi sa bon btab pas/ yul dang 'phrad pa'i dus su/ 'bras bu pha gir snang ba de/ rnam shes pha gir 'phos pa ma yin/ rnam shes las g.yos pa med de/ med par ma byung*/ rnam shes 'gags shing gsal bas ni rnam shes shes bya'o// sa dang po'i bden pa mthong nas/ ming du shes bya'i sgrib par btags te/ de spong ba ni bsgoms pas spong ba las/ gzhan gyis mi spong*/ de spong ba'i thabs ni/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang 'dra ste/ lcags rdog po cig la ye nas gser yin pa la/ bzo bos rtsi byugs pas/ lcags je chung la song*/ gser je che la song nas/ mthar gser gyi rang bzhin du 'gyur ro// de bzhin du/ shes bya la ye shes kyi rang bzhin ye nas yod pa la bla ma'i man ngag gis mtshon nas/ shes bya rim gyis 'gag /ye shes rim gyis gsal du song nas/ tha mar rgyud dag pa'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ro/ yang pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'dod pa ni/ mthong ba'i lam gyis ji ltar mthong ba'i don de/ sa bcu'i bar du goms par byas pas/ sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas/ las srid pa'i sa bon rnam shes 'gags nas/ skad cig ma gnyis pa la bde ba chen po chos kyi sku dus thams cad du chad pa med pa mngon du gyur pa yin gsung*/

gsang sngags pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi 'od gsal la goms par byas pas bar do dang po'i dus su snang ba 'gags nas/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal la gnas pa'o// der gnas ma nus na/ da rung shes bya'i sgrib pa ma 'byong pa yin/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ni/ bslab pa (20ba)gsum gyis rtsad nas gcod/ las kyi sgrib pa rtogs pas 'dag par byed do// de la dal 'byor rnyed dka' nas mgo btsugs nas/ stong nyid rnal mar ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen cig 'tshol ba gal che'o// chos bya rgyu la bsags sbyang gnyis las med/ bsod nams bsags pas sdig pa byang*/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa 'od gsal ba 'di rgyu las ma byung ste/ lam rim la brten nas bsod nams bsags shing byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas 'di mthong ste 'ong bas/ rgyu las byung bar yang btub/ rkyen las ma byung ste/ tshogs gnyis bsags pas 'di mthong ste 'ong pas/ rkyen las byung bar yang btub/ thabs las ma byung ste/ bsags sbyang gnyis la brten nas/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas 'di mthong ste 'ong bas/ thabs las byung bas yang btub/ thabs goms dbang gis bdag nyid kyi// gang gis shes pa rnam sgom na// des ni bde ba myur du thob// bdag med gcig pu bsgoms pas min// de bas na/ bsod nams bsags pa gal che/ de la bogs gang che na/ bla ma la bsnyen bkur byas pa che ste/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa che gsung*/// / zhi gnas skye ba'i rgyu bzhi ni/ bla ma'i byin rlabs las skye ba dang*/ rten 'brel las skye ba dang*/ tshogs bsags pa las skye ba dang*/ sdig pa sbyang ba las skye ba'o// sems nyid kyi ngo bo ni/ ma bcos ma bslad pa de/ rnal mar gsal ba dag pa/ dus thams cad pa/ rgyun chad med pa de yin te/ de la snang la nges pa dang*/ snang la ma nges pa'o// ston ka'i nam mkha' dwangs pa lta bu dang*/ sems nyid (21na)gnyis su med par rtogs pa de snang la ma nges pa yin/

yar sangs rgyas la mi re/ mar 'khor ba la mi dogs gzhan gyis bsgyur yang mi 'gyur ba de snang la nges pa'o// ma yengs pa de la yang nyams su myong ba cig la/ zhi gnas kyi bde ba dang mi rtogs pa 'ong ste/ nyams la res yin nam snyam/ res min nam snyam pa de ni/ mi rtog pas rgyu byas nas mar ldog nyen yod gsung*/ gzugs khams sam/ gzugs med khams sam/ 'gog pa'i rgyur yang 'gro nyen yod/ dang po slob pa'i dus su rig pa gsal sing ba la bslab/ de yang shes pa ma yengs pa la bslab/ de yang rig pa ma yengs pa la bslab/ de la goms nas nges shes skye ba yin gsung*/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo ma shor bar byas nas/ rnam rtog ci tsam 'phro ba 'phror 'jug pa yin gsung*/ rnam rtog byung yang chos sku yin/ dpe nam mkha' lta bu rang bzhin gyis dag pa yin yang*/ sprin dang na bun la sogs pa ji tsam byung ba nam mkha' rang la dengs pa dang 'dra/ sprin dang mdog ni tha dad kyang*/ ngal la sogs pa byung yang gsung*/ de yang rnam rtog gi grogs su 'gro ba yin gsung*/ rnam rtog 'phror mi btub na slar thu ba yin/ gzugs med du skye nyen yod gsungs/ yi dam lha'i bskyed rim yang res bsgom/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyis yi dam lhar bskyed nas/ 'od gsal 'ba' zhig sgom pa yin gsungs/ de yang*/ gsal sing nge ba de nyams myong yin/ de la ma yengs pa gnas pa yin/ shes rab kyis bltas pas ci ngo bor yang ma grub pa de rtog pa yin/ tshe 'di blos btang ba cig dgos pa yin gsungs so/// /yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ (21ba)chos nyid stong pa la dngos po'i khong tshangs mi gzhug /rig pa gcer bu la mtshan ma'i gos kyis mi dkri /sems nyid gnyug ma la chags sdang gi rten mi bca'/ ye shes rnam dag la dge sdig gi blos mi dpyad/ mtshan ma rang grol la bdag 'dzin gyi mdud pas mi gdab/ ye stong ye grol la dngos po'i mtshan ma mi gzung gsung ngo*//

chos rje'i gsung*/ dbang bzhi'i lam sgom du ma 'khrid lags/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rin po che'i zhal nas/ dang po dbang bzhis smin par byas nas/ grol bar byed pa la/ thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis sgom dgos/ rdzogs rim la yang gnyis/ spros bcas rtsa rlung thig le sgom/ spros med skyes sbyor ram/ phyag rgya chen po sgom/ lam dang sbyor na/ tshogs lam rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor/ sbyor lam spros bral gyi rnal 'byor/ mthong lam ro gcig gi rnal 'byor/ sgom lam sgom med kyi rnal 'byor/ gsang sngags kyi dbang du byas na/ mi slob pa'i lam/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbang du byas na/ mthar phyin pa'i lam mo// de ltar yin yang sgom dgos/ bla ma rje btsun la re skyid byas pas/ nga bzhin byas pas chog pa la gsung ngo*// chos mi bya bzhin nyal bas mi 'ong gsung*/ ngas dang po ther tsam cig gon nas bsgoms pas/ mtshon par gos de min cig gon nas nyal 'dug /de nas snying rus bskyed nas bsgoms pas/ drod chen po byung gsung*/ de nas dus rtag tu brtson 'grus chen po byas gsung ngo*/// /yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ gang zag gi bdag med dang bskyed rim sbyor/ chos kyi bdag med dang rdzogs (22na)rim sbyor/ tshogs lam du ngos 'dzin/ mthong lam du mngon sum du byed/ sa bcu man chod du rjes sbyong ba'i yon tan la rang snang gsung*/ rang shar rang rig gis/ rang myong rang stong*/ sgom rtogs nas/ mi sgom pa dang*/ bsgom pa gnyis/ sgom pa sla/ bor du mi btub gsung*/ gsal la rtogs pa med pa/ de ma nor ba/ lus sems bde ba gsum la/ gsal ba'i dpe ston ka'i nyin phyed la cer re bltas pas/ gsal sing nge 'dug pa lta bu'o// mi rtog pa ni/ dbugs rgyu ba chad pa snyam pa 'ong*/ dwangs pa ni snod gtsang mar chu blugs pa la bltas pas dwangs sing nge 'dug pa lta bu'o// phra ba ni dpe dngos por snang ba cig yod na de gsum gyis mi rtogs mi srid gsung*/

rtags la/ khong nas dga'/ mdangs gsal sems rgyud rab tu dwangs/ sdig sems cher thul/ rngam sems nga rgyal med/ rjes la shes bya'i sgro 'dogs chod/ zhen pa chung*/ skyo shas bskyed/ las 'bras 'dzems gsung ngo*// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ yul dang mi chos zug rngu bskyed par byed pa'i nad dang 'dra bas rgyab tu bor// zas nor mi rtag nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon 'dra bas de la yid ma chags// tshe srog mi brtan rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra bas brtson 'grus bskyed// bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen yid bzhin nor bu 'dra bas mos gus mchod pa gyis// gdams ngag zab mo 'tsho ba'i kha zas 'dra bas rtag tu nyams su long*// dal 'byor rnyed dka' u dum me tog 'dra bas don med spyod pas chud ma gzon// sdug bsngal rtsa ba dngos 'dzin yin pas stong nyid sems dang ma bral cig /kun rdzob (22ba)bden pa mi slu nges pas rgyu 'bras khyad du ma gsod cig /'bras bu mi zad 'phral du 'byin pa'i ljon shing 'dra bas byang chub sems mchog rtag tu sgoms// 'dod pa dug gi lo ma 'dra bas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs yid la gyis// zhes gsungs so/// /yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ da ni gnas lugs kyi sgom pa ston/ dbang po rab lta thog tu bzhag pa dang*/ 'bring sgom thog tu bzhag pa dang*/ tha ma chos spyod kyi thog tu bzhag pa'o// sgom pa la gnyis/ lta thog nas sgom 'tshol ba dang*/ sgom thog nas lta ba 'tshol ba'o// 'di ni sgom thog nas lta ba 'tshol ba yin pas/ da ni 'di ltar bsgoms par bya ste/ sems nyid gsal la 'dzin med kyi shes pa rtog med du tsen ne zhog /gsal bas chad pa'i mtha' sel/ 'dzin med kyis rtag pa'i mtha' sel/ bden pa de rgyu med de/ bzang ngo snyam pa'i nga rgyal med/ ngan no snyam pa'i 'dzin pa'i skyon gyis ma gos/ sems nyid la rnam rtog gi lhad ma zhugs/ rig pa rang gsal rtog med du lhan ne zhog /de ltar bzhag pa'i dus su rtog med kyi ye shes phyogs med rang grol du 'char gyis gsung*/

de ni bsgom pa'i skyabs shes kyang bya/ rgyab rten zhes kyang bya ba 'di/ rkang grangs bco lngas bstan te/ dang po kho na rig pa stong par 'gyur bas/ 'gyu ba rang sangs kyi gdams ngag bstan pa dang gcig /rnam rtog la skyar zhon btang ba dang gnyis/ bde ba ngos bzung med pa dang gsum/ wal po rjes med dang bzhi/ dran pa rang yal dang lnga/ gsal ba rtog med dang drug /snang la 'dzin med dang bdun/ khyab pa zhen med dang brgyad/ nam mkha'i bya bzhin rig pa rten med dang dgu /nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhin sems (23na)nyid 'phro 'du med pa'i ngang la bzhag pa dang bcu/ chu bo rgyun 'bab bzhin sems nyid rgyun chad med pa'i ngang la bzhag pa dang bcu gcig /gsal cha ma 'gags la 'dzin cha ma zhugs par bzhag pa dang bcu gnyis/ snang la rtog med lhug pa dang bcu gsum/ ris med du snang zhing zhen med du shar ba dang bcu bzhi/ sgom med rgyud la thebs nas/ 'dzin med rang sar grol bar bstan pa dang bco lnga'o// gnas lugs sgom pa'i gdams pa/ rin po che'i thugs dam/ zang lung dgon par bris pa'o/// /snang ba 'di sgyu mar mthong bas na sgyu lus/ sgyu ma de stong par shes na 'od gsal/ de gnyis tha mi dad pas na zung 'jug go /kun rdzob tu yang stong na 'chal ba'i shes rab bo// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyis/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ stong pa gsum la brten nas/ rtogs pa rgyud la skrun/ sngags kyi lugs kyis/ lus lha/ ngag sngags/ yid chos nyid dang gsum la brten nas rtogs pa rgyud la skrun/ ma rtogs na sangs mi rgya/ deng rang gi chos kyi 'khyer lugs 'dis/ yar 'gro ba las mar mi 'gro ba yin gsung*/ dbang po rab sangs rgya ba yin/ 'bring 'phags pa'i gnas lngar skye ba yin/ tha ma lhar skye gsung*/ bden gnyis kyi dbang du byas na/ dran rig sna tshogs kun rdzob yin/

sems nyid kyi ngo bo don dam yin/ da lta'i ngo bo'i nyams 'di sangs rgyas kyang 'ong ba yin/ shes pa sna tshogs su shar yang longs spyod du btub ste/ chab rom la chu 'byung ba bzhin no// stong pa snying rje dbyer mi phyed pa ni/ 'od (23ba)gsal las 'od chad pa bzhin du 'dod/ rtog pa thams cad 'od gsal las 'od chad pa bzhin du 'dod/ gnyid che yang mi lto// ngo bo skye 'jig dang bral bar rtogs na/ mi 'jig pas chog pa yin/ chos thams cad hril gyis dril na/ rtog pa rtog med gnyis su 'dus/ rtog pa rang yang chos sku yin/ gcig tu rtogs pas thams cad tshur thob nas 'ong ba yin/ khyed cag la bya rgyu yang med de/ 'on kyang don med/ bla ma'i gsung gi thog tu yang mi phebs/ rtog ge ba'i yul las 'das pa yin/ rtog pas mthong na kun rdzob kyis don dam mthong bas/ don dam yang 'jig par 'gyur/ don dam gyis mthong na rtog pa dang bcas par 'gro/ 'o na'ang byas pas shes rab mig gis de mthong 'gyur/ bya ba yin/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ rig pa dang po ngos zin nas/ de nyams su blang ba'i thabs/ sems ma bcos pa lhug par bzhag pa dang*/ de nas nyams su myong ba ni/ rnam rtog thams cad chos nyid ro gcig tu myong ba dang*/ de nas rtogs pa ni/ khyab dang rdo rje'i sku nyid dang*// mi 'gyur dus ni thams cad pa'o// khyab pa ni nam mkha' dang 'dra ste/ skye med kyis phyi nang snod bcud yongs la khyab/ rdo rje'i sku ni mi 'jig pa yin/ mi 'gyur ba ni gdod ma nas rang bzhin lhun grub yin pas skye 'gag med pa'o// dus thams cad pa ni/ 'das ma 'ongs da ltar ba lta bu ma yin te/ rgyun chad pa med pa'o// rtogs pa nam mkha' dang 'dra ste gar yang khyab/ nyams myong sprin dang 'dra ste gar yang 'gyur/ gnyis med shes pa chu dang 'o ma 'dra// rang bzhin rnal ma glang po lta bur bsgom// gnas (24na)lugs don la 'gyur ba med pa yin// dang por

thams cad gcig tu/ rtogs/ bar du 'dris ma yengs par/ tha ma klong ye shes de/ du gyur nas sangs rgyas pa yin gsung*/ gnyis med du rbad kyis chod pa'i dus su rtse gcig la sogs pa gcig yin/ ma rig pa la sogs pa gcig yin gsung*/ sgom du yod byas kyang 'gal ba med/ ngo bo rgyun chad pa med/ lar nang gi rten 'brel gyis/ phyi'i snang ba 'jig dgos pa yin/ 'gro drug sems can gyi ngo bo dang*/ 'phags pa gnyis kyi ye shes dang sangs rgyas kyi thugs gsum gcig yin/ rtogs nas sems can 'phags pa gsum gnas 'gyur ba yin/ ngo bo lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams la/ rtog pa nyams myong thams cad 'jig pa yin/ 'di phyi bar do gsum mnyam pa nyid du shar na/ bar do'i gdams ngag mi dgos/ 'od gsal ba ni rgyun par gnas/ bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*/ sems can sangs rgyas gnyis med du rtogs na/ sdud pa nas gsung pa de yin/ snying rje chen po bskyed kyang sems can 'du shes med/ ngo bo'i nyams rgyun chad med pa 'di kun rdzob yin na 'jig pa'i skyon yod/ don dam yin na bden pa mthong ba'i skyon yod/ rje btsun don dam seng ge phru gu dang zla ba tshes pa'i ngos nas yin te/ gnyis su med pa'i ngos nas yin/ du bzhed/ bde ba chen po dbyer med du bzhed/ bya yul ba kun rdzob tu bzhed kyang*/ de las logs nas don dam mi 'tshol bas don mthun du 'dug go /rgyu 'bras gcig pa'i gnad gas rgyu yod pa cig la/ 'bras bu med pa cig 'dod na chad lta yin/ mu stegs rtag chad gnyis dang khyad par med/ gsang (24ba)sngags tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgya ba yin/ rten bzang ngan med/ sdig che chung mi rtsi/ ngo bo ma shar na sdig pa sbyong dgos/ sems la sdig pa yod pa yin/ ngo bo shar ba la sdig pa med pa yin/ sems tsam pa rig pa rtog ge ba'i yul las 'das pa/ gsal ba la 'dzin pa yod par 'dod pa yin/

gsang sngags pa rig pa skye med du 'dod pa gsal la 'dzin pa med pa yin/ ngo bo dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs/ mi gzigs/ gzigs par mi 'gyur/ mthong ba med/ dngos po dang mtshan ma'i ngos nas/ ngo bo skye 'gag dang bral ba/ rgyun chad med pa/ gsal la rtog pa med pa/ bde ba chen po ni gzugs cig yin na/ nam mkha'i khams su mi shong ba yin/ lan cig dbugs chad nas mi rnams kyis shi zer yang*/ rang cag ngo bo dang ma bral bas shi ba med pa yin gsung*/ nyams phyir ngo bo shor ba bya ba/ bde gsal byung na dga'/ ma byung na mi dga' na nyams phyir shor ba yin/ nyams ngan yang*/ ngo bo ma 'gags na/ nyams rtogs pas thob pa yin/ gnyid log tsa na yang ngo bo rgyun chad pa med/ rtog pa 'phro ba na nyams rgyun chad kyang*/ ngo bo la rgyun chad pa med pa yin/ snang grags thams cad gcig tu shar nas/ de'i ngang la ma yengs par sgom pa yang ngo bo yin/ yengs ma yengs mi rtsi/ chod che shos yin/ mnyam pa yin gsung*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo de/ gzhi gcig pa'i ngos nas thams cad la khyab pa cig 'dug /ngo bo yod med gnyis las 'das pa'i ngos nas/ khyab bya khyab byed med pa cig 'dug /de gnyis ka yin gsung*/ skye med kyis thams cad la khyab pa yin/ ngo bo mthong (25na)ba med pas khyab pa med pa yin/ rang gsal rgyun chad med pa 'di/ rnam smin gyi lus spangs nas gsal dag rgya cher 'gro ba yin/ de dus rnal 'byor pa lus rgya zhig pas/ da lta las brgya 'gyur gyis gsal la rgya cher 'gro ba yin gsung*/// /pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags gnyis kyi khyad par ci zhe na/ lam nye ring la khyad yod/ nā ro'i lugs kyi sgom yod yin/ mai tri'i lugs kyi sgom med yin/ lam gyi dus su sgom yod yin/ 'bras bu'i dus su sgom mi sgom rtsis gdab med/ chos thams cad gcig yin/ nyams dang rtog pa gcig tu 'dod pa yin/

yod pa gzhi med/ med pa tsam du med pa yin/ so so rang rang la nges nges yod kyang*/ rtog pa can la dris pas/ nam mkha' dang 'dra bar stong pa cig 'ong ba yin/ sems kyi ngo bo 'di rtogs na/ lus bor ma bor med par/ mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin/ lus bor bas bzang du mi 'gro /gsang sngags pa la lam rtsis med pa yin/ don rtogs ma rtogs las med pa yin/ gzugs sku gnyis kyi rgyu rtog pa rgyun ma chad ring la skad cig gis yi dam lhar bskyed/ de las 'byung*/ rtogs pa rang gis kyang 'ong ba yin gsung*/ dge ba yang byar med/ sdig pa yang shugs kyis mi byed pa cig 'ong ba yin/ da lta'i lus 'di dang po ma rtogs pa'i lus yin pas/ gso dgos pa yin/ byams snying rje blos bskul dgos ring la sgom/ mnyam nyid kyi ngang la ma yengs pa lam yin/ 'bras bu la yengs ma yengs rtog dpyod med pa yin/ las dang po la snang ba dgrar 'char/ sgom chen pa 'bring la snang ba grogs su 'char/ sgom chen (25ba)pa rab la snang mi snang gi rtsi gdab med pa yin/ dbu ma rig pa drug cu pa bya ba snang sems gcig tu 'dod pa yin/ kun rdzob tu yod med gnyis dang bral ba'i snang ba la nyams su len pa yin/ de nam rgyun chad dus sangs rgya bar 'dod/ de bas bla ma'i bzhed pa mtho bar 'dug gsung*/ mthun snang gi skabs su sgyu ma tsam ming tsam la rtsi ba yin pas/ yar longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la bde ba ci yod dang*/ mar dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gnyis mnyam pa min nam byas pas/ yin zer/ 'o na yar tshogs gnyis gsog mi bsog /mar sgrib gnyis sbyong mi sbyong byas pa la/ lan ma thebs/ sgrib gnyis sbyong na khyad byung ba yin pas/ da ci'i mnyam pa'i dam bca' zhig pa yin/ longs sku yang ming tsam/ mnyam pa yang ming tsam/ yar gyi tshogs gnyis dang*/ mar gyi sgrib gnyis kyang ming tsam yin/ rang gi sems snang tsam yin pa de tsam du mnyam gsung*/

sngags kyi dbang du byas na phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbang du byas na mthong lam skyes pa las yar skyed 'don rgyu med/ yar phul na rten ci 'dra cig gis 'phul/ thabs ci 'dra ba cig gis 'phul/ 'phul rgyu med na/ gnad ka ci 'dra cig gis med/ dbang po yang rab la gsang sngags/ pha rol tu phyin pa gang la yang rten med yin gsung*/ rnal 'byor pa yang rab cig la/ rtogs pa sangs rgyas dang khyad med pa yin/ yon tan la khyad yod pa yin/ dbu ma dang phyag rgya chen po man chad la/ ma gi mu stegs nyan thos yan chod du song ba cig /lta ba la dgag sgrub med pa yin/ ngo bo yod pa cig la cis kyang bar du mi chod pa yin/ rang gi 'dzin pas ma rtogs pas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam rtags bskyed (26na)kyang 'byung ba med pa drang don yin gsung*/ bskyed rim mchog dang thun mong gnyis ka'i rten yin gsung*/ gnyid shes rab yin/ rmi lam thabs yin/ 'od gsal shes rab yin/ snang ba thabs yin/ ngo bo bsgoms pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i snying rjer 'gro ba yin/ snang ba rig pa byang chub kyi sems su shar ba yin pa/ rang snang du ngo shes pas chog /ci yang bya mi dgos/ dam tshig hril dril ba rtog par 'dus pa yin/ gdod ma nas gnas pa'i chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa yin/ ngo bo chos sku yin pas sangs rgyas pas bzang du mi 'gro/ dmyal bar song bas ngan du mi 'gro ba yin/ ngo bo rnal mar rtogs pa skyes pa'i shugs las gsal ba mi 'gegs pa yin/ bar du mi chod pa yin/ ngo bo skyes pa la nyams yod pa yin/ myong byed 'gegs pa yin/ yang dag par sangs rgyas pa'i sa na bsam brjod las 'das pa yin/ sdom pa dam tshig thams cad sems su 'dus pa yin/ spong ba'i lam/ sbyor ba'i lam/ sgyur ba'i lam/ gzhi shes pa'i lam/ dge bshes sgre pa'i zhal nas/ las rgyas sdom pa shor ba med/ sdig pa sbyong dgos/ bla ma'i zhal nas/

bre'i nang du phul bcug pa dang 'dra/ rang lus kyi sdom pa gcig gsung*/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ sa dang po'i bden pa mthong nas zag med kyi sdom pa yin/ dge mi dge byed mkhan rang gcig po yin/ ngo bo rtog med rang gsal yin/ mi 'gag pa yin/ gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes dang*/ sher snying gi zab mo rnam brgyad kyis phog pa yin/ ngo bo rtog med des thams cad la khyab pa yin/ gnyid log pa'i dus dang*/ ra ro ba'i dus dang*/ brgyal ba'i (26ba)dus dang*/ 'chi ba'i dus na yang rgyun chad pa med pa yin/ sngags nas/ gnyid chos skur bshad/ rmi lam sprul skur bshad/ gnyid du ma song ba longs skur bshad kyang*/ don la rmi lam rtog pa yin/ rtogs na gtum mo la sogs pa bsgoms pas ngo bo rang yin/ ngo bo ma rtogs bar du gang sgom yang rtog pa yin/ nyams thog tu ngo bo shor ba skyon chung shos yin/ de ltar sbyangs pa'i ngos nas 'dra/ rtog pa'i thog tu nyams shor ba skyon che shos yin/ so sor thar pa'i rtsa bzhi shor yang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la shor ba med gsung*/ gal te las kyi dbang gis 'chi 'gyur na// rang byung ye shes yongs su med mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// rang rig pa'i ngo bo skye 'jig thams cad dang bral bar rtogs na/ bsam gtan med cing rtog pas sangs rgya ba'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pas/ gnas pa yun thung bas mi sto/ yun ring bar 'dod pa skyon can yin/ rtog pa phra mos mi sto/ rang gi ngo bo yin/ gar 'phros pa'i sar gtong dang tshur log 'ong gi /so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis phyi nang gnyis su brtags te/ ci ltar brtags na/ ci yang ma yin pa'i don skye 'jig thams cad dang bral ba de las bzang ba logs na 'dug mi 'dug blta ste/ rtog med kyi ting nge 'dzin dran med du phyam gyis song bar bsam la/ de dang rig pa gang dga' bltas pas/ rtog med de lung ma bstan du 'dug pas/

des kyang don mi 'grub/ de bas tha mal gyi shes pa dga'/ yang nam mkha'i khams thams cad lha dang lha mos gang bar bsam la/ de rnams kyis bdag yar drangs pas/ bdag dang de rnams tha mi dad du bsam la/ gang dga' (27na)bltas pas/ de yang sems kyi rnam 'phrul 'gyur ba can yin pas/ de bas tha mal gyi shes pa dga'/ de bas kyang rang nyid sangs rgyas su byas la/ sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs dang bcas pa/ de yang 'ja' tshon lta bur bcos la gang dga' bltas pas/ de yang bskyed rim byas pa yin pas ngos bzung can du song*/ de bas kyang tha mal gyi shes pa dga'/ yang mtshan nyid pa'am/ bka' gdams pa bzhin du gzung 'dzin gnyis ka ma grub par byas nas/ chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar blos byas la gang dga' bltas pas/ de yang blos byas kyi chos stong pa nyid yin te/ de bas kyang tha mal gyi shes pa dga'/ yang rang la mngon par shes pa yod par byas la gang dga' bltas pas/ mngon shes lha la yang yod/ lha dag a cang che/ mo ma la yang yod de/ de tshe 'di pa yin/ 'dre la yang yod de/ go ma chod/ de bas kyang tha mal gyi shes pa dga'/ tha mal gyi shes pa de la/ kyai'i rdo rje las/ gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs so/// /rin po che'i zhal nas/ rtogs pa nyams myong dang ldan pa'i bla ma rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ sa ha dza'i ye shes ni/ da lta tha mal gyi shes pa yod pa 'di nyid yin gsung*/ de ngo shes par byed pa la/ bla ma'i gsung la brten nas tha mal gyi shes pa 'di nyid/ ma bcos par bzhag /ma bslad par bzhag /rang sor bzhag /rang dgar bzhag /de ltar bzhag pas/ rang sems skye med du rtogs/ 'gag med du (27ba)rtogs/ gnas med du rtogs/ dngos po med par rtogs/ snang grags 'di yang de dang 'dra bar rtogs pa de lta ba yin gsung*/ de ltar sems kyi don la dus thams cad yengs pa med pa de sgom pa yin/

de ltar sems nyid skye ba med pa dang snang grags gnyis/ chu dang chu'i rlabs ltar gnyis med du rtogs pas las 'bras la spyod pa ni spyod pa yin gsung*/// /yang gsang sngags kyi lam ni thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis yin te/ bskyed rim ni/ rab kyis zung 'jug gi don rtogs/ 'bring tha ma gnyis kyis tha mal gyi zhen pa zlog /yang na/ rab kyis lhar mthong ste bde mchog la sogs pa rang gang byed kyi lhar mthong*/ 'bring gis sgyu mar nges/ tha mas mos pa byed/ yang na tha mas rang lhar gsal/ 'bring gis gzhan lhar gsal/ rab kyis rang gzhan gnyis ka lhar snang ba de sgyu mar rtogs gsung*/// /rdzogs rim ni/ rab kyis rang sems dbu mar rtogs/ 'bring gis rig pa'i ngo bo skye med du rtogs/ tha mas spros bcas la brten nas rtse gcig sbyong*/ yang na rab kyis ngo bo ji bzhin par rtogs/ 'bring gis dbugs 'gro 'ong mi tshor bar rtogs/ tha mas lus 'di med dam snyam par rtogs// zhes gsungs so/// /rin po che'i zhal nas/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis ni/ dbyings zhes bya ba ni/ chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid do// ye shes shes bya ba ni/ sems nyid rnam par dag pa 'od gsal ba'o// chos zab mi zab 'bring po gsum las/ mi zab pa ni/ rgyu dge mi dge yod par bzung ba las 'bras bu bde sdug yod par myong nas/ las 'bras la yid ches pa'o// 'bring po ni 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i (28na)chos thams cad yod ma myong*/ re zhig rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'o// zab pa ni/ gnyug ma ni rgya mtsho chen po dang 'dra zhing gting mi rnyed pa'o// chos dang*/ chos can/ chos nyid gsum ni/ chos ni 'khor 'das kyi chos blo'i yul du gyur pa'o// chos can ni/ der 'dzin par byed pa'i shes pa'o// chos nyid ni/ ye nas ma grub pa'i rnam par dag pa'o// dbyer med phyag rgya chen po ni/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su chos nyid rten/

rnam rtog dbang du 'dus pas dbang*/ chos nyid dbang du byed pas dbang gi nges tshig go /lus byang chub kyi sems ni bsod nams kyi tshogs/ de las ye shes skye bas na ye shes kyi tshogs/ tshogs lam du ba lta bu'i rtags 'byung bas na drod/ sems gong nas gong du 'phel bas na rtse mo/ sems la bzod cing brtan pas bzod pa/ 'jig rten las khyad par du 'phags shing byang chub kyi sems la gnas pa ni 'jig rten chos kyi mchog sbyor ba'i lam/ byang chub sems kyi bde bas chos thams cad nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pas mthong lam/ de la rgyun du goms par byed pas sgom lam mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu'i lam mo// ༈ //

dwags po sgom tshul gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma'i phyag 'tshal// na mo gu ru/ bde ba chen po'i ngang shar nas// gsang sngags ma lus ston mdzad cing*// ye shes rgyun chad med pa yi// rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag rgya chen po'i ngang shed nas// sprul sku'i skal ldan 'dren mdzad cing*// dus gsum mnyam par gzigs pa yi// rje tai lo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'od gsal zung 'jug ngang shed nas// (28ba)dka' spyad mtha' phyin mchog brnyes nas// gzhan phan thugs rjes gzigs pa yi// rje nā ro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// gsang sngags rgyud sde'i ngang shed nas// 'od gsal rgyun chad med pa yis// gzhan 'pho grong 'jug mdzad pa yi// rje mar pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rlung sems gnyis med ngang shed nas// 'od gsal rgyun chad med pa yis// don rnams kun la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rje mi la'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// mnyam med rje btsun rin po che// cir snang chos skur ston mdzad cing*// bde ba chen por gzigs mdzad pa'i// rje dus gsum gsal la phyag 'tshal bstod// nyin mtshan dus gsum thams cad du// mnyam bzhag ngang las ma g.yos pa'i// rnam snang mdzad kyi sprul pa cig /rje ye shes rgyun la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// thugs rje'i chu rgyun mi gcod pa'i// spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa cig /rje 'gro ba 'dren la phyag 'tshal bstod// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho na// nyon mongs nad kyis gzir ba la// sman pa'i rgyal po'i sprul pa cig /rje dug lnga sel la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// sna tshogs sgo nas smin par mdzad// ye shes sgron me 'degs mdzad pa'i// rje sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gis khyed la de bstod pas// de las byung ba'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi// nyon mongs nad rnams sel bar shog// /bla ma mnyam med rin po che// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// 'gro ba'i
